name: get_party_member_position_x

stack.evidence: func_001D5DC8 uses the top value to index the three-object party registry at D_002DEC00 and replaces it with the integer-converted position X float at object offset 0x10

notes: D_002DEC00, D_002DEC04, and D_002DEC08 hold the player and two companion slots. A null slot leaves the input value unchanged. All 174 JP calls pass slot 0 for the player; 162 pair this result with command 292 for the player's Z position.
